name: coverage10
purpose: Train on 10 datasets, evaluate end-to-end on the 24 held out, to measure whether a sampling scheme improves generalisation to UNSEEN domains. The held-out sets span a novelty gradient (cosine distance 0.63-1.01 to the nearest training dataset), so a scheme can be shown to help only on the far end rather than uniformly.
selection: Greedy farthest-point on per-dataset DINOv2 centroids, seeded with the largest segmentation dataset. Maximises coverage of the embedding space rather than picking the biggest or most typical datasets.

excluded_entirely.artaxor-bbox: 0% polygon labels - cannot train or test a mask head

caveat: Deliberately unbalanced: biodiscover is 46% of the training images, and Mothitor (11) and gernat2018 (31) are included for coverage, not size.
